That’s why I created an agent app that runs exclusively on iOS—it doesn’t require a separate computer or server; it runs entirely on your iPhone. Plus, in the latest version, we’ve become the first to integrate Jev AI—a very popular decision-making AI—on the App Store. We invite you to try it out, and we look forward to your feedback.
